gates.name: reference-agreement:friedman_vs_scipy_baser
gates.detail: 10/10 agree [Q_statistic=420.13 vs ref 420.13; neg_log10_p=90.015 vs ref 90.015; df=3 vs ref 3; max_diff_scipy=5.6843e-14 vs ref 0; max_diff_baser=0 vs ref 0; rank_open_firm=1.3101 vs ref 1.3101; rank_closed_foam=3.9241 vs ref 3.9241; monotone_order=1 vs ref 1; n_subjects=158 vs ref 158; k_conditions=4 vs ref 4]
gates.citation: Friedman M (1937) rank-sum test. Reference impls: scipy.stats.friedmanchisquare and base R stats::friedman.test. Data: COP path length (PhysioMoCap::swayMetrics) across four vision x surface quiet-standing conditions, Santos & Duarte (2016) BDS balance dataset (figshare).

reference.citation: Friedman M (1937) rank-sum test. Reference impls: scipy.stats.friedmanchisquare and base R stats::friedman.test. Data: COP path length (PhysioMoCap::swayMetrics) across four vision x surface quiet-standing conditions, Santos & Duarte (2016) BDS balance dataset (figshare).
reference.description: re-computes the tie-corrected Friedman chi-square of COP path length across the four conditions with scipy.stats.friedmanchisquare and base R friedman.test and confirms friedmanTest reproduces base R bit-for-bit and scipy to machine precision; also reports the per-condition mean ranks, the monotone ordering and the design sizes
